form:FormGroup.label: Cluster configuration
form:FormGroup.helpText: Elasticsearch cluster document that holds the connection details for this index. Only clusters you have Use permission on are listed.

form:FormGroup.label: Index name or pattern
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of the Elasticsearch index to search, or a pattern matching several indices or a data stream, e.g. events-*

form:FormGroup.label: Main date field
form:FormGroup.helpText: Name of the date field used to apply the query time range. Usually @timestamp, especially for data streams. If left blank, @timestamp is used.

form:FormGroup.label: Number of slices
form:FormGroup.helpText: Number of slices to query at the same time when retrieving search results. Increasing this can speed up retrieval from large indices. 1 to 1000. Default is 1.

valuespinner:ValueSpinner.title:
Number of concurrent threads to use to retrieve search results.
Increasing this value can speed up retrieval for larger indices.

form:FormGroup.label: Scroll size
form:FormGroup.helpText: Number of documents to retrieve in each scroll batch when searching. 1 to 1,000,000. Default is 1000.
form:FormGroup.screenReaderText: Documents per batch, 1 to 1,000,000. Default is 1000.

valuespinner:ValueSpinner.title: How many results to retrieve each batch

form:FormGroup.label: Default extraction pipeline
form:FormGroup.helpText: Pipeline used to extract field values from the original events at search time, when a dashboard or query does not specify its own extraction pipeline.
